functionDescriptions: Hydrolyzes rapidly the acetylcholine neurotransmitter released into the synaptic cleft allowing to terminate the signal transduction at the neuromuscular junction. Role in neuronal apoptosis. {ECO:0000269|PubMed:11985878, ECO:0000269|PubMed:1517212, ECO:0000269|PubMed:1748670, ECO:0000269|PubMed:2714437}.
